notes: Wall INSIDE Confed hexes along N edge. Layers tagged; DamageModificator=35. HoS: no hexside/directional combat. Prefer DM35 over fortification tile.
damage_modificator_notes: HoS stock: Plain=0, Forest/ThinForest=25, Hill=15, City=40, HillForest=50, Mountain=60. Stone wall=35 (between forest and city). Bonus is NOT directional — HoS has no hexside facing.

hos_fortification_research.recommendation: DamageModificator 35 only; do not use fortification tile
hos_fortification_research.why_not_fortification: Fortification tiles (ex-trenches) and bunkers are whole-hex; dev confirmed no side/rear attack system, so not directional or owner-only. Would fight unique SV_K art (WWII trench look).

alternatives.entrenchment: Unit field EntrenchmentLevelOnStart (-15%/level); optional for Confed units on wall hexes
alternatives.bunker_unit: Engineer-built armor unit; wrong scale/era for dry-stone wall
alternatives.earthwork_fort_tile: Named fort tiles exist in ACW.sav as VPs; not a field wall
